description.en: Slightly smaller than its counterpart, the Rail Rack 6 provides the same level of durability and design efficiency but is tailored for setups requiring a compact solution. It holds up to 6 mining units and is ideal for miners who prioritize space-saving without compromising on the performance and thermal management necessary for continuous mining.
